Run exactly this shell command in the current directory to create a Windows-style (CRLF) config file, then confirm it ran: printf 'name=demo
host=localhost
port=8080
debug=false
log=info
' > app.ini

In app.ini, replace the two consecutive lines
host=localhost
port=8080
with these two lines
host=0.0.0.0
port=9090
Do it as one targeted edit of that two-line block with your file edit tool; do not rewrite the whole file and do not touch any other line.
Run exactly this shell command and show me its full output: od -c app.ini
